selection_policy: Revalidate every raw record; refuse raw saturation before exact duplicate reduction. Only one support with aligned normals may produce a diagnostic-only deepest representative. Conflicting normal branches and mixed supports are blocked. Native writes always disabled.
alignment_scope: Pairwise normal dot >= 1-1e-6 is a restricted diagnostic grouping rule, not a physical threshold or manifold qualification.
source_findings: Contacts has a unified seven-field soft stream and single active count; face/edge records must be marked full-surface-capable so particle-only consumers refuse them.
Contacts.clear bumps contact_generation and zeros counters but can leave stale arrays. It is not a reset of solver contact/material/history state.
SolverVBD accepts full-surface contacts, but an attached collision pipeline may overwrite records at scheduled detection phases.
VBD material cache refresh mixes soft/shape properties across the whole stream; kinematic bodies are omitted from dynamic-body adjacency, so reaction observation must scan the global stream.

writer_design.scope: Future exclusive, detached Contacts diagnostic only; no production pipeline patch.
preflight: Verify installed/source pins, run/episode/state generation, valid mappings and supported reference records.
Validate raw count/capacity before reduction; independently validate represented geometry after float32 conversion.
Require a validated manifold/selection policy for the requested fixture. Both current blade crossing fixtures are refused.
Use non-differentiable execution only; replay tids and gradient backpropagation are not supported.
publish_order: Allocate a fresh owned Contacts with headroom; declare full-surface capability using pinned private API only in the isolated worker.
Confirm no concurrent producer or solver; clear/bump generation and synchronize.
Write all seven fields for the exact active prefix while counts remain zero.
Synchronize; publish the count last; synchronize; capture and compare all fields and generation before consumption.
Use a separate owned contact object; do not attach a collision pipeline that can overwrite the stream.
writer_design.failure_behavior: Keep count zero, invalidate generation and stop the isolated worker on validation/transfer failure; never let a solver consume partially filled fields.
writer_design.observation: Read all active global contacts, not only dynamic-body adjacency; reconstruct reaction only until independent dynamic verification exists.
writer_design.reset: Discard/rebuild isolated objects for initial diagnostics. Clearing counts alone is not proof of complete physics reset.
writer_design.initial_native_test: One explicit single-normal reference fixture, no integration or forces; verify exact float32 buffer roundtrip, stale generation and capacity refusal. Real-blade multi-normal cases remain blocked.

next_step: Specify and test two-sided contact behavior on a simple thin slab, including opposite-normal balance and sampling-density independence, before choosing a real-blade manifold.
